The main takeaway from our work is that
host choice is not an “on-off” decision, but is based on a continuous scale, with the threshold of acceptability set at a low level.
the genetic distance between a host and its non-host can be very small, and yet, the host is still utilized by the gall former.
the genetic distance between the wasp’s normal host and the hybrid hosts is not sufficient to prevent parasitism by the wasp.
